stages.desc: Stage0 canonical MAGNET-SHROOM: large RED horseshoe U-magnet upright with TWO chunky squared SILVER/WHITE metal pole tips. Two friendly glossy dark oval EYES sit directly on the lower LEFT and RIGHT ARMS OF THE RED MAGNET, not on the mushroom stalk. Red magnet rests on a low flat PURPLE SPOTTED MUSHROOM SAUCER CAP. Under cap is short pale cream/light-green mushroom stalk, widening directly into a continuous ground base. No green leaf pedestal at this mushroom stage. No additional mouth is needed. Match actual game layout: red U-face, purple saucer cap, pale stalk. Cap is not a big round dome, stalk is not a purple humanoid face. Walking cap/stalk softly squish and U-face tilts; no feet or hands.

Stage1 canonical GOLD MAGNET from original PvZ. Refer to ONLY the plant pictured in the upper green almanac illustration, ignore all text/frame/background. An upright shiny GOLD/YELLOW horseshoe U-magnet with TWO squared pale-gold pole tips, and two small friendly dark oval EYES on its lower U-arms. Supported by a curled GREEN stem and a collar of pointed green leaves tucked under lower U, merging into a small rooted green base. NO purple mushroom cap or purple-face stalk at this canonical Gold Magnet stage. The plant's face is the gold U itself, not leaves or support stalk. No mouth, no coins in source frames, no human limbs/feet. Keep iconic simple gold U and leafy botanical support.

Stage2 MEGA MAGNET, project's natural evolved extension of canonical GOLD MAGNET. Use one broader sturdier shiny GOLD/YELLOW upright horseshoe U with TWO thicker squared pale-gold pole tips, slight subtle gold structural band detail near poles and the same two friendly glossy dark oval EYES directly on lower U-arms. A fuller green pointed-leaf collar and curled green support stem root directly into a broader flared green base. One magnet, one face, not two separate U-heads, no purple mushroom cap, no humanoid body. No crown, gems, machinery arms, limbs or coins. Larger magnetic U silhouette than Gold Magnet while clearly the same actual-game botanical family. Face never moves to leaves/stem. No mouth; open attentive eyes at idle/walk, cheerful closed eye arcs in cheer, closed tired eyes in KO/sleep.
